_comment: Recipe types for which the firmages-core gate detects no output in any recipe (logs/firmages-recipe-audit.txt, 'Types with no detected output'). Each is accepted: it makes no item, or its result is derived from its input, or every input belongs to the same or a later Age. dev/poc_analyze.py G-4 fails on a type that is not listed. Reviewed 2026-10-01 on the pack test server (35,114 recipes).

types.ad_astra:space_station_recipe: builds a space station in orbit, no item output; inputs are age_7+ Ad Astra items
types.ae2:crafting_unit_transform: turns a placed AE2 crafting unit block into another; AE2 is age_6 and both blocks are AE2 items
types.ae2:matter_cannon: ammunition weight table for the matter cannon, no output
types.ae2:storage_cell_disassembly: returns the housing and component of a cell; the cell (input) is as late as its parts
types.almostunified:client_recipe_tracker: Almost Unified bookkeeping, not a usable recipe
types.apotheosis:gem_cutting: upgrades the rarity of the input gem (output = input)
types.apotheosis:reforging: rerolls affixes of the input item (output = input)
types.apothic_spawners:spawner_modifier: changes a placed spawner's stats, no item output
types.ars_additions:bulk_scribing: copies a spell onto scrolls (output = input)
types.ars_additions:imbue_scroll: writes onto the input scroll (output = input)
types.ars_additions:locate_structure: ritual effect that locates a structure, no item output
types.ars_additions:source_spawner: ritual effect on a spawner, no item output
types.ars_nouveau:alakarkinos_conversion: loot table of the Alakarkinos familiar, no crafting output
types.ars_nouveau:armor_upgrade: raises the tier of the input armour (output = input)
types.ars_nouveau:dispel_entity: dispel effect on an entity, no item output
types.ars_nouveau:enchantment: enchanting apparatus: enchants the input item (output = input)
types.ars_nouveau:reactive_enchantment: adds a spell to the input item (output = input)
types.ars_nouveau:scry_ritual: ritual that highlights blocks, no item output (the diamond scrying ritual is removed by the pack)
types.ars_nouveau:spell_write: writes a spell onto the input book (output = input)
types.ars_nouveau:summon_ritual: summons an entity, no item output
types.createbigcannons:munition_fuzing_deploye: puts a fuze on the input shell (output = input)
types.createbigcannons:tracer_application_depl: adds a tracer to the input round (output = input)
types.firmalife:smoking: adds the smoked trait to the input food (tfc:copy_input)
types.immersiveengineering:generator_fuel: diesel generator fuel list, no output
types.immersiveengineering:windmill_biome: windmill speed per biome, no output
types.immersivepetroleum:reservoir: worldgen data for pumpjack reservoirs, no item output
types.mekanism:energy_conversion: item to energy, no item output
types.mysticalagriculture:enchanter: enchants the input item; inputs need Mystical Agriculture essence (age_6)
types.mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner: spawner entity table, no item output
types.tfcrf:regrowth: TFC Regrowing Forests world data, no recipe output
types.theurgy:catalysation: turns the input into mercury flux energy, no item output
types.twilightforest:uncrafting: uncrafting-table cost overrides; the table only reverses recipes that the gate kept
